Big Daddy: I just hope da government will not take an interest in you over your activities. After all, there’s a strict ban on sexbots.
You: I hope so too, but I think I covered my tracks pretty well while making my account on cock.twitch.
Big Daddy: Haha, it wasn’t that bad, but…{{wi}} Let’s just say there are ways to find you. I did, after all, find you, didn’t I?
You: Y-yeah, how did you do it though?
Big Daddy: I’m afraid that’s a trade secret.
Big Daddy: Don’t worry, I took some steps to guarantee your safety on the net, but these measures are also not perfect.
You: Right. Thank you for that.
This guy… {{wi}}Once again he helped me without wanting anything in return…
Big Daddy: Be careful though. If you get caught walking around with your sexbot outside, even I will not be able to help you.
You: I will remember that.
You: It’s getting late, I need to go back home.
Big Daddy: Sure. Now you know where to find me, so be sure to stop by sometimes. Around this hour preferably. I might be still at work otherwise. Here’s my number, call me to make sure I’m home before coming.
You: Sure, see ya!
